question: In December 2021, which State Assembly passed two bills to reserve 50% seats for women for 10 years on a rotational basis in constituencies of the civic bodies in the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per Joined Countries in its report **"Ladies in Governmental issues"** distributed in the year **2017.**
 
• **Panchayati Raj organizations (PRIs) **play had a huge impact in bringing ladies delegates at grass-root level. Many States have allowed half booking for ladies applicants in races.
 
• Major changes at the party level will act as a fundamental and key commendation to the** Ladies' Booking Bill.**
 
• Turn of saved electorates in each political race might diminish the motivator for a MP to work for his voting demographic as he might be ineligible to look for re-appointment from that supporters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bill was presented in the** Rajya Sabha in May 2008 **and was alluded to a standing council.
 
• **In 2010, **it was passed in the House and communicated at long last to the **Lok Sabha.**
 
• Orientation equity is a piece of Reasonable Improvement Objectives too.
 
• A nation by name 'Rwanda' presented share framework for ladies, almost half ladies won, which in this way rose to **64%**, in any event, when the specified quantity was just **30%**.
